$comment: farmline Photo Kit v0.1 — the guided farm photography prompts. Airbnb's Professional Photography Program was their single biggest early growth lever: listings with good photos booked, listings without them didn't. This is that, delivered in-app, for free, on a phone the farmer already owns. Photos are not decoration here — they ARE the storefront and the primary trust artifact.
principles: Natural daylight only. Never flash. Shoot within two hours of sunrise or before sunset.
No people in the listing photos unless the farmer chooses to appear — the FARM is the brand.
One clear subject per shot. Get close. Fill the frame.
Shoot in landscape AND portrait for the hero; portrait only for produce.
Never stage produce the farmer wouldn't actually sell.
Re-shoot the hero every season — a farm photo from three years ago reads as neglect.
If the feed trough is dirty, fix the trough. Do not fix the photo.

shots.use: Top of the shop, receipt footer, WhatsApp share card

prompt.sw: Piga picha ya lango la shamba, asubuhi, ukielekea ndani.
prompt.en: Show me the farm gate, in the morning, looking in.

why.sw: Hii ni picha ya kwanza mteja anaiona. Inajenga uaminifu mara moja.
why.en: This is the first thing a customer sees. It sets trust immediately.

shots.framing: Stand 3 m back. Include the gate, a piece of the path, and some sky. Hold the phone level — the horizon should be flat.
shots.avoid: Dust glare, blurred gate, a person's back filling the frame

prompt.sw: Onyesha shamba lako kwa ujumla — sehemu kubwa ya mazao.
prompt.en: Stand in your main plot and show the whole crop.

why.sw: Mteja anataka kuona kwamba kuna shamba halisi, si kibanda cha kununua.
why.en: Customers want proof of a real farm, not a reseller.

shots.framing: Wide. Include the crop rows leading away from you. Fill the lower two-thirds with crop, not sky.
shots.avoid: Empty ground, a single plant filling the frame

prompt.sw: Piga picha ya chupa au ndoo ya maziwa, na ng'ombe nyuma kidogo.
prompt.en: Show the milk in a clean container, with the cow slightly behind it.

why.sw: Inaonyesha maziwa yanatoka wapi. Inauza zaidi kuliko picha ya chupa peke yake.
why.en: It shows where the milk came from. It sells far better than a container alone.

shots.framing: Hold the container at chest height. Let the animal be soft in the background.
shots.avoid: A dirty container. Rusty metal. Anything that looks unwashed.

prompt.sw: Onyesha tray ya mayai, mabichi na masafi.
prompt.en: Show a full tray of eggs, clean and unbroken.

why.sw: Mteja anajua ubora kwa kuangalia. Mayai yaliyovunjika yanaua oda.
why.en: Quality is visible. One cracked egg kills the order.

shots.framing: Top-down. Whole tray in frame. No gaps.

prompt.sw: Piga picha ya mbuzi anatembea, ukiwa kando yake — si juu yake.
prompt.en: Photograph the goat standing, from the side, not from above.

why.sw: Ubora wa mbuzi unaonekana kwa mwili mzima. Mteja anajua anataka nini.
why.en: The animal's condition is the product. A side view shows it fully.

shots.framing: Side-on, all four legs visible, head up. Whole animal in frame with a little space above the horns.
shots.avoid: Top-down shots, partial animal, only the head

prompt.sw: Onyesha mahindi yaliyovunwa, na tano bichi.
prompt.en: Show the harvested cobs you have, and peel back one.

why.sw: Kufunua moja kunaonyesha ndani iko aje — hio ndio inauza.
why.en: Peeling one open shows what's inside. That's what sells it.

shots.framing: Three-quarter view, cobs facing camera. Peeled one at the front.
shots.avoid: Dried-out or mouldy cobs in frame

shots.use: Shown on the profile near the Compliance Score

prompt.sw: Piga picha ya mahali unaposafisha na kupanga maziwa au mayai.
prompt.en: Show where you wash and pack the milk or eggs.

why.sw: Wateja wanaogopa uchafu kuliko kitu kingine. Picha safi inaondoa hofu.
why.en: Customers fear uncleanliness above everything else. One clean photo removes the fear.

shots.framing: Clean surface, clean containers, natural light. Wide enough to show the space.
shots.avoid: Clutter, dirty cloths, animals inside the packing area

prompt.sw: Onyesha ng'ombe au mbuzi wako wakiwa wazima, wakila.
prompt.en: Show your cattle or goats healthy and feeding.

why.sw: Wanyama wanaofanya vizuri wanaonyesha shamba linajaliwa.
why.en: Thriving animals signal a well-run farm.

shots.framing: Eye-level with the animals. Show condition, not just heads.
shots.avoid: Emaciated animals (do not hide them either — fix the cause)

shots.purpose: Trust — the human behind the food

prompt.sw: Kama uko tayari, onyesha mikono yako ikifanya kazi — kupanda, kukama, au kuvuna.
prompt.en: If you're willing, show your hands at work — planting, milking, or harvesting.

why.sw: Mteja ananunua kwa mtu, si kwa kampuni. Uso au mikono inaunganisha.
why.en: People buy from a person, not a company. A face or hands creates the connection.

shots.framing: Hands and action in focus. Face optional — the farmer's choice, always.
shots.avoid: Anything the farmer is not comfortable publishing. Consent is absolute here.

prompt.sw: Onyesha malisho na maji safi unayowapa wanyama.
prompt.en: Show the feed and clean water you give the animals.

why.sw: Mteja anayeuliza 'wanakula nini?' atapata jibu bila kukuuliza.
why.en: The customer who wonders 'what are they fed?' gets the answer without asking.

shots.framing: Close, clean, well-lit. Feed trough filled, not scattered on the ground.
shots.avoid: Mouldy feed, stagnant water, dirty troughs

capture_ux.entry: Offered at the end of farm setup, and again when a listing is created without a photo.
capture_ux.framing_guide: Draw a live rule-of-thirds overlay with a horizon lock. Warn if tilted more than 3 degrees.
capture_ux.light_check: Warn if the shot is backlit (subject darker than background) or taken after 6pm.
capture_ux.data_rule: Compress on-device to under 120 KB before upload. Never upload a raw 4 MB phone photo over mobile data.
capture_ux.offline_rule: Queue photos locally and upload when on wifi or when the farmer chooses. Never block logging on an upload.
capture_ux.minimum_viable: Hero gate + one photo per listing. A farm can go live with four photos.

first_cohort_service.$comment: Airbnb sent photographers to hosts' homes. For the first five design-partner farms, do the same thing manually: one visit, a half-day, shooting the whole kit. It is the cheapest possible growth lever and it produces the reference images every later farmer is measured against.
plan: One half-day visit per design-partner farm, golden hour where possible.
Shoot the full required set plus the recommended trust shots.
Deliver as a ready-to-use profile gallery, then show the farmer the before/after.
Use the same five farms' shoots to train the in-app framing prompts.
Offer the service to the next cohort at cost, or as a Rung 3 incentive.

consent_rules: Any photo containing a person requires that person's explicit in-app consent before publishing.
Children must never appear in customer-facing photos.
The farmer may delete any photo at any time; deletion is immediate and complete from the customer face.
No photo may be used by farmline for marketing without a separate, explicit opt-in.
